note: Every dependency edge that pointed the wrong way when semantic checking was switched on. It is a record, not a permission: tools/verify-dependency-graph.php fails on any edge not listed here, fails when a listed edge no longer exists so the entry has to be deleted, and fails when an entry passes its expiry. The baseline therefore only ever shrinks, and phase 3 empties it — its exit gate is that this tooling reports zero unapproved or expired violations.

approved_interfaces.interface: ManifestContributionSet::fromManifest() and ::legacy() as the manifest's one admission-time contribution parser, and the resulting set held as the typed contributions member.
approved_interfaces.justification: The manifest is the frozen extension-contract artifact: refusing invalid contributions at manifest admission is pinned by six generations of signed fixtures, so the parse cannot move outward without changing when packages are refused. ADR 0012 records the exact interface instead.

approved_interfaces.interface: CapabilityDefinition read only to project declared capability identifiers into the manifest's permission set.
approved_interfaces.justification: Declared capabilities feed the manifest's permission vocabulary at the same admission boundary; the projection reads one identifier and nothing else. ADR 0012 records the exact interface instead.
